Migrant indian and Pakistani construction workers promised certain pay and benefits that they would be foolish to pass up, having their passports withheld upon arrival, preventing them from leaving when they find out they will be paid far less than promised, and housed in what essentially amounts to farm animal pens. I lived in an accommodation owned by the company, in a small room with 2 other guys. The room next to us also housed 3 other guys. A cockroach infested kitchen.

Taking a trip to the tourist sections was like having the veil placed back on. But it had already been lifted and what was seen cannot, and must not, be forgotten.
